title: Natural language processing evaluation of trends in cervical cancer incidence in radiology reports: A ten-year survey
details: P López-Úbeda, T Martín-Noguerol, A Luna - Radiography, 2025
abstract: Introduction Cervical cancer commonly associated with human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, remains the fourth most common cancer in women globally. This study aims to develop and evaluate a Natural Language Processing (NLP) system to …
